desc:
Anime Crossover Defense has been remade!
Explore a world where strategy and planning are the keys to victory.

This game aims to heavily emphasize the tactical elements of the Tower Defense genre. 
- Every single Unit has two upgrade paths! 
- Get rewarded for beating hard stages, where your own skills made the difference, not just grinding. 
- Compete against other players in ever changing gamemodes
- Coordinate with your friends and team to beat the toughest challenges
